to forb kidney biopsy and couldn't do it due to insufficiency of money den suggested to visit KIMS for second opinion den he underwent investigation and suggested dialysis again then his dialysis treatement was started heree on 08\/07\/21 for every 2\/3 days he continued it till 10\/09\/21(21times till dis date)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;then he stopped too visit KIMS two months back\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThen he had 3 episodes of seizers since 4 days where they visited a doctor in NALGONDA and admitted for\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;2 days and then discharged on 21\/12\/2021\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe he had seizers 2 episodes\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1,at 3am\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2,at 11am\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThen on the way to hospital\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast history :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt is known to hypertensive since\u0026nbsp;
